Robyn Beck / AFP via Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 20, 2026, 7:07 PM EDT By Rebecca Keegan Following a dramatic C-suite reshuffle and its largest round of layoffs in years, Netflix’s top executives reassured investors Tuesday that they have a plan to keep audiences hooked. The streaming giant announced that its third-quarter revenue grew 12% year over year, to $12.9 billion, while net income rose 48%, to nearly $3.7 billion. “Our engagement is solid, and it will allow us to continue to grow as we have for the last several years,” co-CEO Greg Peters said on the streamer’s third-quarter earnings call, referring to the company’s performance in the U.S. “But we know that we can do better.” Revenue increased despite upheaval at Netflix, which last week laid off roughly 1,000 employees, or 6% of its workforce, and ousted Chief Content Officer Bela Bajaria and top film executives Dan Lin and Doug Belgrad. “We believe we have a responsibility to make hard trade-offs in service of our members, our partners, our employees, our investors and ultimately our long-term growth,” Peters said of the layoffs. “That was the simple thinking behind it and what motivated these recent changes.” Ted Sarandos, Peter Rice, Bela Bajaria and Dan Lin. items.t: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
items.d: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 2:25 PM PDT · October 20, 2026 Image Credits: Getty Images Rebecca Bellan Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy Anthropic is having trouble securing enough cloud capacity from AWS, Google, and Microsoft, which increasingly see the Claude-maker as a competitor rather than a customer, according to an S-1 filing leaked to The Wall Street Journal . The leaked filing provides more color to the numbers Reuters and the Financial Times reported in late September, including that Anthropic believes it could spend more $750 billion on cloud contracts, some of which includes deals still in negotiation. And still, that is not enough. Anthropic is leasing its own data centers and working with third-party data center operators. But the firm worries those operators have a “limited operating history,” which could make them less reliable than the hyperscalers. Anthropic’s enormous spend comes on the back of an $80.7 billion net loss in the first half of the year. The company reported $16.3 billion in revenue during that same time period, with only two customers accounting for about a fifth of sales, according to the WSJ report. Building on previously reported catastrophic risk disclosures, the filing also warns that Anthropic could be held liable for damages caused by harmful AI behavior to a tune that would exceed available insurance coverage. Last week, the company told prospective investors that third-quarter revenue alone has now reached $16.8 billion , up 45% from the previous quarter. Anthropic is reportedly targeting a November IPO. Anthropic did not immediately respond to TechCrunch’s request for comment. items.t: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
items.d: SpaceX hit profitably in the third-quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.
items.fullText: SpaceX’s data centers and Grok agents were more profitable than investors expected in third quarter of the year, as the company leaves its roots as a space company behind to focus on artificial intelligence, which now makes up 52% of its income. CEO Elon Musk’s deep tech conglomerate reported $14.6 billion in third-quarter revenue on Tuesday, according to its regulatory filing . That number was driven by growth in all segments, but especially its renamed “Super Intelligence” business line, which generated $7.5 billion in revenue from the recently acquired Cursor coding tool, Grok bot, and most importantly, the company’s burgeoning neocloud business, which now boasts 1.7 GW of compute. The AI business generated $431 million in profit, which would have been higher without $1.2 billion in one-time stock-based compensation expenses related to the Cursor acquisition. The top-line revenue number was also boosted by about $1 billion in income related to the recovery of Bitcoin prices and unspecified related-party income that might be attributed to a SpaceX investment in another company. The growing revenue is balanced against total capital expenditures of $19.6 billion, as SpaceX continues to build out a second data center project, Colossus II, and increase investment in Starship, the heavy-lift rocket it sees as vital to deploying a new generation of Starlink satellites and developing orbital data centers. CFO Bret Johnsen said the company would spend $35 billion to $40 billion on new capital investments in the fourth quarter. items.t: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
items.d: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 1:35 PM PDT · October 20, 2026 Image Credits: FotografiaBasica (opens in a new window) / Getty Images Julie Bort OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business OpenAI on Tuesday acquired a four-year-old AI biotech software startup called Orchestra Bio, the company announced via its website. Terms of the deal were not disclosed, but the startup had reportedly raised around $20 million as of 2025 from backers like Andreessen Horowitz, Atria, and 8VC. Orchestra creates AI agents that help biotech companies manage the minutiae of drug discovery operations, from tracking finances to resolving scheduling issues with clinical trials. OpenAI says it’s adding Orchestra’s team and technology to work on Rosalind , its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results. OpenAI has already won some big names as customers for Rosalind, including, it says, Moderna⁠ and Novo Nordisk⁠. The acquisition is a classic example of how the biggest AI labs (namely OpenAI and Anthropic) are building ever more software for the biggest industries, like pharma. In the startup world, there is an ongoing fear that at any moment, the labs will launch new features and become competitors. In this case, Orchestra is getting absorbed, rather than stomped out. items.t: Cracks are beginning to show in the stock market as doubts about AI investments grow
items.d: Consumers already face a host of stressors. If AI spending and tech stocks show signs of sustained decline, U.S. economic growth could be at risk.
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Cracks are beginning to show in the stock market as doubts about AI investments grow Consumers already face a host of stressors. If AI spending and tech stocks show signs of sustained decline, U.S. economic growth could be at risk. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Nearly half of all U.S. economy growth this year is attributable to tech-related spending, which has lifted the stock market to record highs. Michael M. Santiago / Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 15, 2026, 11:38 AM EDT / Updated Oct. 15, 2026, 5:33 PM EDT By Rob Wile Just one week after hitting fresh all-time highs, U.S. stocks are showing signs of strain as investors begin to fret about returns on the trillions of dollars that have been put into AI. For U.S. consumers, it could mean a shakier economy moving forward. After trading closed Thursday, the S&P 500 was off 1% from its week-ago record, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq had fallen more than 3% below its peak last week. Driving the declines: Quarterly revenue growth at Anthropic has slowed, the Financial Times reported Wednesday. The AI giant is expected to be worth more than $1 trillion when it goes public, and at nearly $17 billion, its revenue is still massive and the company said it is profitable. There are also rising concerns about whether China-based memory technology companies could undermine, or even overtake, their Western rivals. And even though the AI data center buildout has created a global shortage of processing chips, there are fears that Chinese mass production of memory chips could flood the market with an oversupply. Meanwhile, investors have begun selling off the bonds backing some data centers , primarily over fears that AI revenues won’t be sufficient to cover the massive sums that have been borrowed to finance the building of the centers. items.fullText: Dial Up the Cloud: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 Controls Arrive on GeForce NOW Plus, stream ‘Enshrouded’ 1.0 and ‘Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2’ alongside 10 new games this week. October 15, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Dial in the next gaming session this GFN Thursday. New NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 controls give GeForce NOW members more choice over how supported games look and perform in the cloud, even without the latest hardware. Then, step into the Shroud as Keen Games’ Enshrouded leaves early access with its 1.0 release, or let the bolts fly in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 . Both are streaming on GeForce NOW at launch. With 10 new games joining the cloud this week, members can put the new controls to work in supported titles and keep playing across supported devices without downloads, installs or expensive hardware upgrades. Fine-Tune the Cloud With DLSS 4.5 Controls More control, more cloud power. NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 controls are now available on GeForce NOW, giving members more choice over how supported games look and perform in the cloud, even without the latest hardware. DLSS Super Resolution sharpens image quality, while Dynamic Multi Frame Generation delivers lower latency and reduces stutter for smoother streaming, and Ray Reconstruction enhances ray-traced visuals. In addition, Ultimate members streaming on GeForce RTX 5080-powered cloud rigs benefit from the maximum available options, including Dynamic Multi Frame Generation up to 4X. From James Bond’s globe-trotting missions in 007 First Light — now with path tracing support — to CONTROL Resonant ’s reality-bending Manhattan and the shadowy scares of Resident Evil Requiem , the controls help fine-tune supported games for image quality, responsiveness or a preferred balance between the two. These new settings are available in the GeForce NOW app under settings, for Windows, macOS, Chrome OS and Steam OS platforms. Members can read here for more details

items.fullText: NVIDIA Expands Advanced Technology Access for Europe’s Scientific Community Through Open Learning Resources, Collaborations and Compute NVIDIA’s participation in the European Commission’s AI in Science Enablers Initiative deepens its commitment to supporting the pursuit of scientific progress across the region. October 15, 2026 by Rod Evans 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Much of today’s scientific progress begins with computation. But turning accelerated computing’s potential into scientific progress — modeling climate systems, designing molecules, simulating materials and more — depends on more than breakthrough technology. Especially for smaller labs, early-career scientists or science-based startups, the hardest part of research can be everything that comes before the science: assembling tools, finding compute and building the expertise to use both. At the AI in Science Summit in Dublin today, the European Commission launched the AI in Science Enablers Initiative, a shared framework connected to RAISE — the Resource for AI Science in Europe — that brings private-sector support closer to Europe’s research community. items.fullText: 삼성전자, 동남아 가전 테크세미나 개최… 맞춤형 AI 가전·통합 공조 솔루션 선보여 2026/10/15 AI 요약 새로운 뉴스룸 AI 기능을 살펴보세요! 닫기 --> AUDIO Play Download 공유 레이어 열기 인쇄하기 삼성전자가 14일 베트남 하노이에서 동남아 가전 테크세미나 ‘더 브리프(The Brief)’를 열고, 현지 사용자의 라이프스타일에 최적화된 AI 가전과 B2B 솔루션을 선보였다. 이번 행사는 지난 8월 개관한 삼성 ‘비즈니스 익스피리언스 스튜디오 (Business Experience Studio, 이하 BES)’에서 진행됐다. 하노이 PVI 타워에 위치한 베트남 BES는 삼성전자의 다양한 제품과 솔루션을 상업시설 콘셉트로 구현한 전시공간이다. 행사에는 태국, 베트남, 싱가포르 등 동남아 국가의 주요 미디어와 인플루언서들이 참석했다. AI 기반 푸드 경험부터 원격 케어까지…차별화된 AI 홈 경험 제공 삼성전자는 가전이 사용자의 라이프스타일과 상황을 이해하고 이에 맞춰 기기를 제어하거나 솔루션을 제안하는 다양한 AI 홈 경험을 소개했다. 특히 냉장고에 탑재된 카메라 기반으로 식재료를 효율적으로 보관·관리할 수 있도록 돕는 ‘AI 비전’ 기능을 시연했다. 사용자는 ‘AI 비전’을 통해 식재료의 입출고 현황을 실시간으로 확인할 수 있다. 자주 사용하는 식재료는 자동으로 데이터베이스에 저장되고 냉장고는 이 정보를 토대로 구매가 필요한 식재료를 알려준다. 이외에도 ▲한 주간의 식재료 사용을 분석해서 리포트 형태로 제공하는 ‘푸드노트(Food Note)’ ▲냉장고 속 식재료를 기반으로 맞춤 레시피를 추천하는 ‘오늘 뭐 먹지?(What’s for Today?)’ 등 다양한 기능을 제공한다. 삼성전자는 ▲전문 상담사가 원격으로 기기의 상태를 정밀하게 분석하고 적절한 조치 방법을 안내해 주는 ‘가전제품 원격지원(HRM)’ ▲와이파이 탑재 제품 대상으로 지원하는 최대 7년간 무상 소프트웨어 업그레이드 등 차별화된 제품 케어 서비스도 소개했다. 주거공간부터 상업시설까지 아우르는 통합 공조 솔루션 선보여 삼성전자는 고온 다습한 동남아 기후와 현지 사용 환경을 반영해 주거공간과 상업시설까지 다양한 공간에 최적화된 냉방 경험을 제공하는 공조 솔루션도 선보였다. 주거용 제품으로는 사용자의 생활 패턴과 공간 환경에 맞춰 냉기 흐름을 제어하는 ‘비스포크 AI 무풍콤보 프로 벽걸이’ 에어컨을 소개했다. 이 제품은 공간을 구분해 냉기 방향을 섬세하게 제어하는 ‘모션 블레이드’와 사용자의 위치·활동량·부재 등을 감지하는 ‘모션 레이더 센서’를 갖춰 사용자의 취향과 환경에 최적화된 냉방을 제공한다. B2B 전용 제품으로는 호텔, 사무실 등 대형 건물에 적용할 수 있는 시스템에어컨 실외기 ‘DVM S2’와 실내기 ‘무풍 1WAY·4WAY 천장형 카세트’를 전시했다. 또 에어컨과 다양한 IoT 기기들을 하나의 플랫폼에 연결하고 다수의 사업장의 기기 상태와 에너지 사용량 등을 한 눈에 관리할 수 있는 B2B 연결·통합 제어 플랫폼 ‘스마트싱스 프로’를 시연했다. 삼성전자 DA사업부 이상직 부사장은 “삼성전자의 차별화된 AI 기술과 연결성을 기반으로 동남아 고객과 B2B 파트너 모두에게 실질적인 가치와 편의를 제공할 것 “이라고 말했다. ▲ 삼성전자가 14일 베트남 하노이에서 열린 삼성 동남아 가전 테크세미나 ‘더 브리프’에서 냉장고에 탑재된 카메라 기반으로 식재료를 효율적으로 보관·관리할 수 있도록 돕는 ‘AI 비전’ 기능을 시연했다. ▲ 삼성전자가 14일 베트남 하노이에서 열린 삼성 동남아 가전 테크세미나 ‘더 브리프’에서 사용자의 생활 패턴과 공간 환경에 맞춰

items.t: 삼성전자, ‘실리콘밸리 미래 통신 서밋 2026’ 개최
items.d: 삼성전자가 현지시간 14일부터 15일까지 미국 실리콘밸리 마운틴뷰에서 글로벌 통신 업계 파트너들과 차세대 네트워크의 미래를 논의하는 자리를 마련한다. 삼성전자는 14일에 ‘파트너 데이(Partner Day)’를 진행했고, 15일에는 ‘실리콘밸리 미래 통신 서밋 2026(Silicon Valley Future Wireless Summit 2026)’을 개최한다. 이번 행사에는 주요 이동통신사∙제조사∙정부 기관∙학계 리더 등 100여 명의 통신 전문가들이 참석해 AI와 다가올 6G 시대 소프트웨어 기반의 네트워크 진화 […]
items.fullText: 삼성전자, ‘실리콘밸리 미래 통신 서밋 2026’ 개최 2026/10/15 AI 요약 새로운 뉴스룸 AI 기능을 살펴보세요! 닫기 --> AUDIO Play Download 공유 레이어 열기 인쇄하기 삼성전자가 현지시간 14일부터 15일까지 미국 실리콘밸리 마운틴뷰에서 글로벌 통신 업계 파트너들과 차세대 네트워크의 미래를 논의하는 자리를 마련한다. 삼성전자는 14일에 ‘파트너 데이(Partner Day)’를 진행했고, 15일에는 ‘실리콘밸리 미래 통신 서밋 2026(Silicon Valley Future Wireless Summit 2026)’을 개최한다. ▲ 14일(현지시간) 미국 실리콘밸리 마운틴뷰에서 진행된 ‘파트너 데이’ 행사 전경. 이번 행사에는 주요 이동통신사∙제조사∙정부 기관∙학계 리더 등 100여 명의 통신 전문가들이 참석해 AI와 다가올 6G 시대 소프트웨어 기반의 네트워크 진화 방향과 통신 산업의 가치 창출을 위한 생태계 협력 방안을 논의한다. 또한, 삼성전자는 ‘AI 내재형 6G 네트워크’ 기술 개발 성과 등을 선보인다. AI 시대의 네트워크 가치 창출을 위한 글로벌 협력 14일 파트너 데이 참석자들은 AI기반 통신산업의 변화에 대응하기 위한 소프트웨어 기반 네트워크 전략과 생태계 차원의 협력 방안을 논의했다. 삼성전자는 기조연설을 통해 AI가 애플리케이션과 서비스를 넘어 인프라 전반을 변화시키면서, 100여 년간 이어진 통신 네트워크도 구조적으로 재편되고 있다고 설명했다. 특히, AI와 가상화를 융합한 차세대 네트워크는 기존의 한계를 넘어 인류가 상상해 온 새로운 방식의 커뮤니케이션을 실현하는 핵심 동력이 될 것이라고 강조했다. ▲ 14일(현지시간) 미국 실리콘밸리 마운틴뷰에서 진행된 ‘파트너 데이’에서 삼성전자 네트워크사업부장 김우준 사장이 기조연설을 하고 있다. 이후, 통신 업계의 집단지성을 모아 AI 시대 네트워크 진화 전략과 방향을 본격적으로 논의하는 시간을 가졌다. 패널 세션에서는 통신 사업자들이 AI 기반 미래 네트워크의 요구사항과 청사진을 공유하고, 제조사들은 AI와 가상화 네트워크 상용화 과정에서 축적한 경험을 나누며 통신 생태계의 지속적인 발전 방향을 논의했다. 또, 단순한 연결 서비스를 넘어 새로운 네트워크 기반 신규 서비스를 발굴해 새로운 사업 기회로 연결하기 위한 방안을 다각도로 모색했다. 삼성전자 네트워크사업부 전략마케팅팀장 박정호 부사장은 “AI 시대의 네트워크는 쏟아지는 신규 서비스의 다양한 요구를 읽고, 가상화를 기반으로 유연하게 변화하며 최적의 답을 제시하는 지능형 인프라로 진화하고 있다”며, “삼성전자는 글로벌 파트너들과 함께 가상화 네트워크의 대규모 상용화를 성공적으로 이뤄왔다. 여기에 앞선 AI 기술을 더해 통신 인프라를 새로운 성장 엔진으로 발전시키고, 업계가 함께 도약하는 길을 앞장서 열어 나가겠다”고 말했다. AI가 불러올 무선 통신의 혁신… 네트워크의 혁신과 확장 15일 개최되는 ‘실리콘밸리 미래 통신 서밋 2026’은 ▲AI 내재형 6G 네트워크(AI-Native 6G Networks) ▲위성통신 기반 6G 커버리지 확장(Taking 6G to Space With NTN) ▲현실과 가상 세계를 잇는 초연결(Connecting the Physical and Digital Worlds) 등 총 3개 세션으로 운영되며, 참가자들은 패널 토의를 통해 자유롭게 질의하고 토론하는 시간을 가진다. ‘AI 내재형 6G 네트워크’ 세션에서는 AI를 통신망 성능과 운영효율 혁신의 핵심 기술로 삼아, 6G 네트워크의 지능형 인프라 진화를 위한 기술적 과제와 협력 방안이 논의된다. ‘위성통신 기반 6G 커버리지 확장’ 세션에서는 저궤도 위성군집의 현황과 미래 전망을 살펴보고 우주 통신의 기술적 장벽과 그 해법으로서의 위성 통신에 대해 토론

items.fullText: NVIDIA Announces New Investments in the UK Startup Ecosystem UK organizations across healthcare, finance, local government and climate science are putting NVIDIA AI to work. October 13, 2026 by Anthony Hills 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Across industries, the U.K. is putting the full stack to work. T he scale of deployment is growing fast, from enterprises transforming their businesses to startups solving some of the planet’s hardest problems. NVIDIA is putting that principle into practice, including through a five-year, $250 million compute commitment to strengthen the U.K.’s agentic safety and security research. NVIDIA’s Investments in the UK NVIDIA has been investing in the U.K. startup ecosystem, supporting companies including Basecamp Research , Ineffable Intelligence , Synthesia , Wayve and many more. Today, NVIDIA announced new planned investments in Boltz , Foresight , Hiverge, Prima Mente and Riverlane . Boltz , a London-based AI startup founded by MIT researchers, builds biomolecular models and AI agents that help scientists predict molecular structures and interactions, and design potential new medicines. Foresight, a London-based startup, helps owners of major infrastructure projects, including hyperscale data centers, predict completion dates, mitigate risks and accelerate time to revenue. Hiverge , a Cambridge-based AI startup founded by researchers from Google DeepMind and the University of Cambridge, builds an AI discovery engine that automatically writes and optimizes algorithms for tasks such as faster AI training and complex logistics planning. Prima Mente , a London-based AI biology startup, focuses on building biological foundation models to decode complex diseases and identify novel therapeutic targets, starting with Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s and ALS.
